fbOgSiteName: I'm Tam. A Interactive Designer in DFW.
workDescription: This was a redesign project for Trinity Rail, one of the largest rail car manufacturers in the world. The site needed a full overhaul from their previous one. So I set out to build it in WordPress and used bootstrap to facilitate the layouts I was going for. One of the main components that I enjoyed building was the mega menu, home page, rotatable 3D railcard renderings and rail car catalog, making it easily accessable for users to navigate through the different products.
